newsitem.title: USA: US CREDIT MKT OUTLOOK-Payrolls, payrolls, payrolls.
newsitem.headline: US CREDIT MKT OUTLOOK-Payrolls, payrolls, payrolls.

text.p: The fate of U.S. Treasuries prices Thursday would hinge on June non-farm payrolls and wage figures, although some U.S. analysts expected that slugglish chain store sales could temper any early sell-off.
The U.S. Treasury market will close at 1500 EDT/1900 GMT, as recommended by the PSA-The Bond Market Trade Association.

Economists appeared to be split on whether the market had more downside risk than upside potential, but agreed that June employment data could exceed expectations, and could, at least initially, cause market deterioration.
